description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.4.0. It contains methods to create and modify database schema elements such as tables, foreign keys, and indexes related to the 'Buzz' social feature module, as well as inserting configuration and menu data.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration to handle database schema updates for the Buzz feature in OrangeHRM version 4.4.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration operations including creating tables, adding foreign keys, indexes, and inserting configuration data for the Buzz module.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '4.4'.
